title: Annual Budget Spreadsheet 2027, Google Sheets and Excel Budget Planner, Monthly Budget Tracker, Debt Payoff, Savings Goals, Paycheck Budget
description:
Tired of wondering where your paycheck went? This Annual Budget Spreadsheet does the math for you: log your expenses and watch your dashboard, yearly overview, debt payoff and savings goals update automatically.

WHO IT'S FOR
Individuals, couples and families who want a clear, simple budget for the whole of 2027, in Google Sheets or Microsoft Excel.

WHAT YOU GET
1 spreadsheet file (.xlsx) with 7 tabs:
1. Start Here - quick instructions
2. Setup - your income sources and up to 30 budget categories
3. Transactions - log every expense with a category drop-down; the month fills in automatically
4. Dashboard - pick a month: income, spent, budgeted, left to spend, budget vs actual for every category, chart
5. Annual - your whole year month by month, with totals and a chart
6. Debt Payoff - snowball tracker with progress bars
7. Savings Goals - targets, amounts saved and progress bars

WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT
- Fully automated formulas, nothing to calculate
- Over-budget categories turn red automatically
- Sample data included so you see it working right away
- Clean, calm design that is easy to read

HOW IT WORKS
1. Download the file after purchase
2. Open it in Google Sheets (upload to Drive) or in Excel 2016 or newer
3. Enter your income and categories in Setup
4. Log your expenses and check your Dashboard

GOOD TO KNOW
- Digital download, nothing is shipped
- Requires a free Google account or Microsoft Excel 2016+
- Amounts display in US dollars by default; change the cell format to use your currency
- For personal use only, no resale
- This is a budgeting tool, not financial advice
- Due to the digital nature of this product, returns are not accepted. Message me if you have any question!
